scope: R13 CPU/native-controller integration, source preservation and offline original-colour visual review. No browser automation, device/GPU/FPS/heat certification.

regression.scope: Node/NullEngine actual-rig 3D attention, complete orbit entry/foot plant, autonomous contact, R13 compact ram/actual prone chase, native player fall, two prone jaw phases, defense/abort/ownership/damage budget, and approved original art and updated R13 collapse/tactical/physical incoming, four-map summon/resource lifecycle, preserved0.1 and shared combat regressions. No browser automation. DeviceFPS/heat/GPU and visual approval are not measured.

preservation.scope: Frozen0.1, shared player/combat/render inputs, R11/R12 source art and shared4K/LOD graph. Only0.2wolf-specific requested behavior/hit representation and newR13art may change.

rows.basis: physical canonical prepared input before R13 edits

independent.qualification: Literal triangle intersections prove overlap; nearest-vertex gaps are upper bounds, not exact surface separations. Small bounded tactile edge cases are reported separately.

bundle.scope: Same active21clip actor and source quality. Historical R9/R12 source keys remain in Node/offline review only. File bytes are not gzip transfer or GPU residency.

visual.scope: Primary agent directly inspected four chronological sheets covering all56 actual CPU-skinned views, selected full-size chase/maul/recovery views, three original-colour authored filmstrips, and front/hind joint colour+matcap sheets. Offline original-colour rendering, not browser/device visual certification.
visual.playerMaterial: Neutral review material; actual native1.6m geometry/pose preserved
observations: Actual native player falls before supported pursuit. Pursuit advances toward the prone torso and two low jaw poses meet the fallen body.
Fore/hind rigid muscle cores do not visibly elongate in the reviewed steps; original angular inner-elbow collar and fur overlaps remain.
Nonlethal collapse and supported rise preserve articulated joints; final gait/watch is the unchanged asymmetric source stance.
No original mesh, UV, weights, bind or4K colour texture replacement was used.
After native get-up the completed maul retains its original attack serial, finishes the authored backstep and reaches watch without replaying recovery.
limits: Static phase views and numerical tests do not establish real-device motion feel, GPU FPS or heat.
Full-surface muscle bands/fur may deform locally; rigid-core preservation does not mean every skin triangle is rigid.

reviewOpinions.observation: The red warning is a generic wolf actor-origin disc; it does not explain the visible mouth path, charge lane or separate pending bite phase.
reviewOpinions.opinion: Show a committed charge lane or local mouth-phase footprint that agrees with the actual contact geometry, then clear each resolved phase immediately. The indicator should help the player predict where a dodge is safe.
reviewOpinions.qualification: The origin was verified by root from the full27-second frame and code. Earlier low-resolution appearance as a player-origin ring was corrected.

reviewOpinions.observation: Repeated stamina warnings cover the central combat area while the player repeatedly tries actions.
reviewOpinions.opinion: A persistent disabled/cost state on the action button and a less repetitive warning could clarify that an input was rejected before any attack. This would separate resource failure from a genuine collision miss.
reviewOpinions.qualification: Stamina rejection may explain some apparent failed inputs. It does not explain all visible misses, and no stamina balance/input change is proposed here.

reviewOpinions.observation: During close front-facing combat, the small warrior is often partly hidden beneath the much larger wolf's muzzle and forequarters.
reviewOpinions.opinion: Review camera elevation/near-fight framing or a subtle player visibility cue. The approved model scale should stay fixed; better visibility would help distinguish a real fall, guard, shove and prone maul.
reviewOpinions.qualification: This is a readability opinion from the supplied camera view, not evidence that model scaling or animation is incorrect.

reviewOpinions.observation: Healing ticks and several damage numbers appear close to the same character overlap.
reviewOpinions.opinion: Clearer ownership/placement of hit, block and healing feedback could reduce uncertainty about which action connected. Keep healing/combat balance separate from any cosmetic presentation decision.
reviewOpinions.qualification: The sheets establish visual clutter but do not identify every individual damage/heal event.

reviewOpinions.observation: BLOCK text/white flash can occur around the same shield action that later performs its outgoing push.
reviewOpinions.opinion: A clearer distinction between held guard, successful defensive block and released push would make the narrow outgoing hit moment easier to understand.
reviewOpinions.qualification: The existing shield cast blocks before its released push window. A defensive block is not automatically proof that the later push damaged the wolf; real animation/surface tests handle that distinction.
